test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure: The keys were found by him under the old wooden table.

options.text: He finds the keys under the old wooden table.
He was finding the keys under the old wooden table.
He is finding the keys under the old wooden table.
He found the keys under the old wooden table.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The subject of the passive sentence becomes the object of the active sentence.
 
• In the given passive voice sentence: "The keys were found by him under the old wooden table."
 
• To convert to active voice: Begin the sentence with the subject "He".
 
• Change the verb "were found" to its active form "found" and retain the object "the keys."
 
• Ensure the phrase "under the old wooden table" remains unchanged at the end of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He found the keys under the old wooden table."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"He finds the keys under the old wooden table." – Incorrect tense (present simple).
 
• **Option 2: **"He was finding the keys under the old wooden table." – Incorrect tense (past continuous).
 
• **Option 3: **"He is finding the keys under the old wooden table." – Incorrect tense (present continuous)
